risk_note: RV2 (packages/domain, pure functions; settlement-plan B2-04f, BR-FUND-04 ③④⑤⑥⑪, BR-FUND-18). Monthly bill functions with no IO and no clock: bill month, the six mutually exclusive check results (only WAITING orders can be 'due but not settled'), split into batches by order_key in raw string order, bill status derived from the latest round of batches, expected settlement credit month and overdue flag, nominal snapshot window [00:00, 00:30) and scheduled-time checks. Dates only through the existing domain calendar functions; settle.* parameters are inputs. Malformed input (empty or duplicate snapshot versions, WAITING without settle_period, duplicate order_key, scheduled batch without scheduled_at, bill_day outside 1-28, negative offsets / grace / tolerance, UNATTRIBUTED in the classification) rejects with RangeError; settlement data arriving after generation started counts as no data.
